# stalwart_report_settings (Resource)

Configures inbound report analysis and outbound report settings. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `inbound_report_addresses` (Set of String) List of addresses (which may include wildcards) from which reports will be intercepted and analyzed
- `inbound_report_forwarding` (Boolean) Whether reports should be forwarded to their final recipient after analysis
- `outbound_report_domain` (String) The default domain name used for DSNs and other reports. If left empty, the default domain will be used.
- `outbound_report_submitter` (Attributes) Report submitter address or leave empty to use the default hostname (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outbound_report_submitter))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--outbound_report_submitter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outbound_report_submitter`

Optional:

- `else` (String) Else condition
- `match` (Attributes List) List of conditions and their corresponding results (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outbound_report_submitter--match))

<a id="nestedatt--outbound_report_submitter--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outbound_report_submitter.match`

Optional:

- `if` (String) If condition
- `then` (String) Then clause
